label: platform sweep
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: After filling a field, previously entered values in other fields (First name, Street address, City) were repeatedly emptied, and the page gave no message about it. I had to re-enter them many times.
Choosing a country reloaded the form silently and cleared First name and Street address, and a new Province textbox appeared with no announcement.
The phone number lost its first characters after typing (it read 2) 555-0142 instead of (212) 555-0142), so I had to re-enter it.
The City field kept coming back empty. The error Please enter city. appeared only as plain text near the field, not tied to the textbox, and the textbox was not marked as invalid.
The Email field was listed as a required textbox but I could not tell from the Province label whether it was required. The country list is shortened (13 options) and the first option is just Select.
The cart page tree contains a duplicate mini-cart section with a second Close button and a second Checkout link, and a Loading text node, making it unclear which Checkout is the right one.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: After filling a field, previously entered values in other fields (First name, Street address, City) were repeatedly emptied, and the page gave no message about it. I had to re-enter them many times.
Choosing a country reloaded the form silently and cleared First name and Street address, and a new Province textbox appeared with no announcement.
The phone number lost its first characters after typing (it read 2) 555-0142 instead of (212) 555-0142), so I had to re-enter it.
The City field kept coming back empty. The error Please enter city. appeared only as plain text near the field, not tied to the textbox, and the textbox was not marked as invalid.
The Email field was listed as a required textbox but I could not tell from the Province label whether it was required. The country list is shortened (13 options) and the first option is just Select.
The cart page tree contains a duplicate mini-cart section with a second Close button and a second Checkout link, and a Loading text node, making it unclear which Checkout is the right one.
